Class Icon

java.lang.Object
com.trevlar.menukit.core.AbstractPanelElement<Icon>
com.trevlar.menukit.core.Icon
All Implemented Interfaces:
PanelElement
public class Icon extends AbstractPanelElement<Icon>
A sprite rendered at a fixed position and explicit size. No interaction. The "show a picture" primitive of the component library.

Works in all three rendering contexts (inventory menus, HUDs, standalone screens). Composable as the render portion of future icon-only Button variants and state-indicating Toggle variants.

Two forms:

  • Fixed sprite — pass an Identifier directly.
  • Supplier-driven sprite — pass a Supplier<Identifier> to drive the sprite from consumer state (toggle states, gameplay events, flip-book animation).

Both forms share the render path — the fixed constructor wraps the identifier in a one-shot supplier at construction time, so per-frame render logic doesn't branch on which form was used.

Hover-triggered tooltip support

Icon tracks hover state internally to support hover-triggered tooltips (via AbstractPanelElement.tooltip(Component) / AbstractPanelElement.tooltip(Supplier)). Hover state is transient (recomputed each frame) and does not affect Icon's structural contract as a render-only element. Icon remains non-interactive — no mouseClicked override — even with hover tracking added.

Scope

  • No automatic sizing — sprite dimensions are explicit constructor parameters.
  • No tint, alpha, or color modulation.
  • No active/pressed state rendering.
  • No timing — consumer-driven animation via supplier.

      public void render(RenderContext ctx)
      Description copied from interface: PanelElement
      Renders this element. Called during the panel background pass (screen space), after slot backgrounds.

      Position the element using the context's content origin plus this element's childX/childY: 

      int sx = ctx.originX() + getChildX();
int sy = ctx.originY() + getChildY();
